Return with [[Goren]] to [[Vehtendi Valley]] and destroy the [[Margonite]] rifts!

== Quest information ==
=== Requirements ===
{{Standard prerequisites
| campaign = Nightfall
| nationality = any
| hero = Goren
}}

=== Objectives ===
* Seal the rifts in [[Vehtendi Valley]] by defeating all demons surrounding each rift. You have 3...0 rifts left to seal.
* See [[Prince Bokka the Magnificent]] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 2,000 [[Experience]]
* 250 [[Gold]]
* 15 [[Lightbringer Promotion Points]]
* [[Trade Contract]]

== Walkthrough ==
As in the preceeding quest, [[Yahnur Market]] is the closest starting point.  Head into Vehtendi Valley and follow your quest pointer to each of the three rifts, where you must eliminate the [[Margonite]]s around them to close the rift.  When you have closed all 3 rifts, return to Prince Bokka in Resplendent Makuun for your reward.

== Dialogue ==
=== Initial dialogue ===
;Prince Bokka the Magnificent
: ''"The strange rifts appearing of late are increasing in frequency. The library scholars have yet to determine what is happening, but it seems you stumbled across something important while helping Diji in '''Vehtendi Valley'''. According to the texts, those rifts you encountered could be connected to the minions surround these areas...in fact, the rifts seem to feed on the things. Destroy the minions, and the rift is sealed...at least, temporarily. We received reports that three more rifts opened in '''Vehtendi Valley''' since you destroyed that one."''
: ''"I can think of nobody better to deal with this threat. Take the '''demons''' down swiftly and without hesitation, or the lands you swore to protect will fall. Go now, and eradicate the rest of these foul rifts from '''Vehtendi Valley'''!"''
{{offer dialog
| accept = A Sunspear never hesitates to mete out justice.
| decline = Wait a minute. The rifts eat the demons? And this is a bad thing?
| ask = Please get on with destroying the '''demons'''...and with them the '''rifts'''...in '''Vehtendi Valley'''. }}

=== Reward dialogue ===
;Prince Bokka the Magnificent
: ''"Stay close. I fear I will need your skills again, brave adventurer."''

== Notes ==
* If this quest is active, [[Jarimiya the Unmerciful]] does not spawn.
